references.text: Parallel account of five loaves and two fish where the disciples gather up the leftover pieces so that nothing is wasted.
Mark's version of the same miracle where Jesus commands the disciples to gather the leftovers to avoid waste.
Luke's account of the bread miracle with the same instruction to gather up the leftover pieces.
Elisha serving 100 men with 20 loaves, where there is an excess that is not wasted, a clear foreshadowing of Jesus' miracle.
